required: public source or frozen official record
inclusion_rule.confirmatory_preference: at least five independent units; smaller tasks are explicitly tiered as limited support
inclusion_rule.nonindependence_rule: channels, cycles, or internal trial blocks nested in one specimen/experiment are not counted as independent units

pva_gpe.title: Stress Relaxation Test Dataset of Cylindrical PVA Gel Polymer Electrolyte (GPE) Samples
pva_gpe.split_rule: leave one specimen out; cycles never cross folds
pva_gpe.scope: limited positive evidence; not a population-level validation

uci_gas.title: Gas sensor array under flow modulation
uci_gas.split_rule: held acquisition batch; channels remain clustered
uci_gas.scope: shared empirical recovery realization, not unique chemistry

uci_hydraulic.title: Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems
uci_hydraulic.split_rule: held cooler-condition group; channels remain clustered
uci_hydraulic.scope: ordinary and AR(1)-profile BIC disagreement is retained

kupferdigital.title: KupferDigital mechanical testing datasets: Stress relaxation and low-cycle fatigue (LCF) tests
kupferdigital.split_rule: leave one material-code group out; specimens from one material never cross folds
kupferdigital.scope: supports a shared empirical rank-one relaxation under AR(1)-profile BIC; not a unique mechanism

hydrogel_candidate.title: Stress Relaxation Timescale and Hydrogel Network Connectivity Regulate Neural Progenitor Cell Stemness and Differentiation
hydrogel_candidate.exclusion_reason: only two independent sample files per condition; internal trial blocks are not independent evidence units
